<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant monoisotopic peak at 134.11 with a clear M+1 peak at ~11 % intensity and rapidly decreasing higher isotopes. This pattern matches the natural 13C abundance (~1.1 % per carbon), indicating the presence of multiple carbon atoms. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S), so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
